name: brainbox
description: BrainBox 0.1.5: the brain checks the spelling of a name once, the first time it writes it down. Found in a real conversation on 0.1.4 - Jim spoke rather than typed, his surname was misheard, and the brain wrote it down as fact. It cannot tell a misheard word from a right one, and being called the wrong name is the fastest way to lose someone. Asked once per name, never again.
